German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul on the "snail shell temptation": There is a temptation in Germany, I would call it the snail shell temptation. We have been able to see it in recent polls too. Pulling in the feelers, retreating into the shell where it is warm and cozy, where one supposedly feels safe. That is an illusion. Whoever hides gives up their ability to act and makes themselves an object. And by the way, there is no back exit from the snail shell. It's not real protection either, as many snails have noticed: when someone steps on it, it's over. If we withdraw, others in the world don't stand still. If we pull in our feelers, others would shape the world. They set the rules, they shift borders in the most literal sense. In short, Germany will not pull in its feelers.
